decision:
step: 4 | missing: whether same-day delivery is offered
The shipping methods listed in kb/02-shipping-policy.md are Standard Ground, Expedited, and Overnight — same-day delivery is not mentioned, and the list is closed ("We offer only these shipping methods").
cases.text:
Unfortunately, same-day delivery is not an option we offer. According to our shipping policy (kb/02-shipping-policy.md), we offer only these shipping methods:

- **Standard Ground**: 5–7 business days — $5.95 (free on orders over $75)
- **Expedited**: 2–3 business days — $12.95
- **Overnight**: Next business day (order by 1 PM local time) — $24.95

The fastest available option is **Overnight**, which delivers the next business day when you order by 1 PM local time. If you have any other questions, feel free to ask!
